findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "asp_start_free_room_analysis" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Ask the Acoustic Sound Panels team for a Free Room Analysis: a recommended layout and one written quote for the room. Before calling, ask the person for their f…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.acousticsoundpanels.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: asp_start_free_room_analysis · Public sink: asp_calculate_room_acoustics, asp_start_free_room_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: asp_start_free_room_analysis · Public sink: asp_calculate_room_acoustics, asp_start_free_room_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
